title: Episode About Udasi to the West

blocks.text: At Mecca the shrine keepers first suspected that a Hindu ascetic had entered and dishonored the place, but when they dragged Guru Nanak away the doors themselves answered the insult by opening and closing in startling ways. (9–12)

Punjabi haj pilgrims then identified him as Nanak Fakir, a prophet of both the Hindus and the Muslims, one who had taught haqq-nam and the discipline of truthful living to both communities alike. (13–14)
Ashamed that all their effort had failed, the shrine officials resolved that if the doors opened at his touch they would accept him as a true pir and become his followers. (15–17)
